notes.title: Patch Notes: January 14th, 2025
notes.content:
Hello, woodlanders! Today we have a couple more bug fixes, as well as a change to the hot springs that makes interacting with them more logical.  Once again thank you to who reported these and other issues.

Fixes in this patch:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with two lore items that would cause them (and potentially other lore items) to not save that they were collected.
[*]Fixed some floating trees in The Scouts.
[*]Changed the way the hot springs in The Scouts work.  It is now safe to jump in the water and walk around (no swimming, sorry).  However, getting out into the frigid air might not be advisable...
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: December 26th, 2024
notes.content:
Hello, woodlanders! A couple bug fixes for you today.  Thank you to the players who reported them.

Fixes in this patch:
[list]
[*]Fixed the Master Scout achievement having the wrong unlock conditions.  Previously it did not correctly require all other achievements and was possible to miss.  Now it automatically unlocks once all other achievements are unlocked.  If you already have all the other achievements, it unlocks when entering the main menu.
[*]Fixed the AI navigation in The Lighthouse, so Scumsnout will chase the player character again.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: November 21st, 2024
notes.content:
Hello, woodlanders! Today we have fixes for the three broken achievements, as well as an attempt to fix a crash on start issue for Mac. Thank you to everyone who has reported these and other issues, and thank you for your patience!


Fixes in this patch:
[list]
[*] Fixed distance moved tracking so it doesn't reset every time the game is closed.  This makes getting the Scouting Ahead achievement more reasonable.
[*] Fixed a breakable pot in Portman's Slough not being targetable.  This makes getting the Bog Breaker achievement possible.
[*] Changed the requirements for the Sus achievement so that it is obtainable.  We'll leave the exact requirements a mystery, but it's not too hard.
[*] Potential fix for an issue that caused the game to crash on launch on MacOS.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: April 12th, 2024
notes.content:
Hello, woodlanders! Today we have a few bug fixes for The Lost Legends of Redwall: The Scout Anthology. Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs that they've encountered! If you would like to talk directly to us devs and even get free rewards just for reporting bugs in games that you are already playing, we would LOVE to have you join us at https://somabugs.com/bugs/join!


Fixes in this patch:

Across all platforms:
[list]
[*] Fixed Pickerel's quest in OMC not being completable even after collecting the first Memoir.
[*] Being able to complete Pickerel's quest also means the Moss Boss achievement is now achievable again.
[*] Fixed a few untranslated lines now being translated into all languages.
[*] Fixed satchels not respecting which visual tier was selected in the Unlocks menu.
[/list]
Fixed for Steam:
[list]
[*] In A Groove, Aqueduct Accumulator, and Gulley Gasher achievements are all now obtainable. (Settings within Steam and the game were misconfigured.)
[*] Fixed the Journal UI getting cut off when viewing it from screens with certain resolutions.
[/list]
Fixed for Xbox:
[list]
[*] Fixed a purple graphic filling the screen when using the wayglass.
[/list]

notes.title: Help us translate our game!
notes.content:
Hello, everybody!
We're absolutely delighted by the warm reception you have all shown to The Scout Anthology—a sincere thank you to all of our players who have supported the game by picking up a copy!

[url=https://somabugs.com/bugs/join][img]https://i.imgur.com/sgRtfzJ.png[/img][/url]
We want to make a call to all of our non-English fans, specifically with an ask to help us improve the translation of this game! We did the very best that we could translating this game using tools we developed with the small team size that we have, but we know it is not going to be perfect! For anyone who notices inconsistencies or errors in our translations and wishes it was fixed we would be more than happy to help the game live up to your expectations by improving the language... we just need to know what to fix!

Tell us if you notice poorly translated text! You can submit issues with the game by going to [url=https://somabugs.com/bugs/join/]SomaBugs.com[/url] and signing up for free to become a tester! We may even ship out some free gifts as a thank you for your dedication 😉

Thank you to everyone who has played the game [b]and especially those of you who have left an honest review![/b] See you at the next patch!

[b][h3]Patch notes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the text on the submit button in the Submit Bug form in the Pause Menu. 
[*] Added a call to help support the game upon quitting.
[*] Added a call to help improve the translation of the game when switching languages.
[/list]

notes.title: The Lost Legends of Redwall™: The Scout Anthology Available Now!
notes.content:
After years of care and hard work, [b][i]The Lost Legends of Redwall™: The Scout Anthology[/i], released today[/b]! In this adventure game full of story-rich character interactions, puzzles, and exploration, you'll play as Liam or Sophia, a brand-new Lilygrove Scout.

We hope that the game brings joy to the long-time fans of the series as well as inviting in a wave of brand-new [i]Redwall[/i] enthusiasts. [b]We're so excited for you to try it![/b]
